name: gke-basics
description: >- Manages core GKE cluster provisioning, credentials, Autopilot vs Standard selection, and workload deployment. Use when creating GKE clusters, fetching kubectl credentials, configuring Workload Identity, or deciding between Autopilot and Standard modes. Don't use for specialized GKE networking (use gke-networking), advanced security hardening (use gke-platform-security or gke-workload-security), or cluster upgrades (use gke-upgrades).
author: google
summary_zh: 用于管理 GKE 集群的创建、凭据获取、运行模式选择和工作负载部署，适合搭建及基础配置集群。
